# Update apps/portal/index.html JSON-LD NeuralLink URL to clean canonical path

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

`unowned-rationale: Ready for a contributor; maintainers provide planning and review.`

## Context

Surfaced during cross-family review of `neomjs/pages#155` (`PRR_kwDODUQIis8AAAABZhkcjQ`, part of `neomjs/middleware-v2#21` / `neomjs/neo#20671`). Once `neomjs/pages#155` and `neomjs/middleware-v2#99` deploy, `https://neomjs.com/learn/agentos/NeuralLink` serves `200 OK` at the clean canonical pathname for both browsers and search crawlers.

## The Problem

`apps/portal/index.html:139` inside `<script type="application/ld+json" data-schema-name="neo-organism">` still declares a hash-fragment URL for the `#neural-link` `CreativeWork` node:

```json
"url": "https://neomjs.com/#/learn/agentos/NeuralLink"
```

Search engines strip `#/...` URL fragments to `https://neomjs.com/`, breaking schema entity consolidation with the canonical prerendered guide at `https://neomjs.com/learn/agentos/NeuralLink`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/index.html` is the source HTML template copied into `dist/production/apps/portal/index.html` during `npm run build-all`, consumed by `neomjs/pages/buildScripts/enhanceSeo.mjs` for root `index.html`, and preserved on `/` by `neomjs/middleware-v2/src/service/SsrService.mjs` (`data-schema-name="neo-organism"`).
- `learn/agentos/NeuralLink.md` lives at `/learn/agentos/NeuralLink` in `sitemap-core.xml` and `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`.

## The Fix

1. In `apps/portal/index.html:139`, change `"url": "https://neomjs.com/#/learn/agentos/NeuralLink"` to `"url": "https://neomjs.com/learn/agentos/NeuralLink"`.
2. Add or extend a unit assertion in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/` verifying that `apps/portal/index.html`'s `neo-organism` JSON-LD emits zero `https://neomjs.com/#/` fragment URLs.

Decision Record impact: `none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `apps/portal/index.html` `data-schema-name="neo-organism"` JSON-LD points `#neural-link` `"url"` to `"https://neomjs.com/learn/agentos/NeuralLink"` with zero `https://neomjs.com/#/` URLs remaining in the JSON-LD block.
- [ ] Unit test under `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/` parses `apps/portal/index.html`'s `application/ld+json` block and asserts valid JSON with no `#/` fragment `url` values (`npx playwright test --config test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/`).

## Out of Scope

- Migrating internal SPA component `route: '#/learn/...'` configs (`DomEvents.upgradeHashRoute()` already upgrades `#/...` links in place under `routerMode: 'pathname'`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Do not run bare `npx playwright test`:** Always pass `--config test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs`.
